description: This file defines the FaultableConsumerGrain class, an Orleans grain implementation that acts as a stream consumer with fault injection capabilities. It manages subscription to a stream, counts consumed and failed events, and allows configuring a failure period.

classes.name: FaultableConsumerGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain implementing a fault-injecting stream consumer, capable of subscribing to streams, counting events, and simulating failures based on a configured time period.

methods.name: FaultableConsumerGrain
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the grain with a logger.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, invoking Reset to initialize counters.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes the grain to a specific stream as a consumer.

methods.name: SetFailPeriod
methods.description: Configures the period during which the consumer will simulate failures.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns the count of successfully consumed events.

methods.name: GetNumberFailed
methods.description: Returns the count of failed event processing attempts.

methods.name: GetErrorCount
methods.description: Returns the count of errors encountered.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles incoming stream events, increments counters, and simulates failure based on time.
